dependencyBinding.scope: Actual installed TypeScript, YAML, Markdown/MDX and Astro parser packages and their declared runtime dependency closures; development dependencies and framework/browser execution are not inputs to this classification.

inputScope.note: Membership and SHA-256 byte bindings include current source files plus tracked in-scope paths missing from the worktree; Git HEAD and index provenance are reported separately from worktree bytes.
